content.text: Valid single solid. Exporting the submission.

I built the flat link and exported it to `submission.step`. The file reads back as one valid solid that matches the part.

**The part:**
- **Size:** a 100 × 60 × 20 plate. It is long along Y, wide along Z and thin along X.
- **End notches:** each end has a half-round notch of radius 12, centred on the end edge.
- **Corners:** the four outer corners are rounded with a radius of 14.

**Orientation:** my first two tries put the long side the wrong way. I worked out the projection for the camera at [-1,-1,-1] and found the long side has to run along Y. The preview of that version matched the reference in all four views.

**One difference from the reference:** the reference has a slight rounding where the side edges meet the large faces. When I added a 1.5 radius there, the solid became invalid, so I left it out. That makes the edges sharp, which should cost very little on a voxel score.

I didn't render a preview of the final version. It only changed the notch radius from 13 to 12 and the corner radius from 12 to 14, so the orientation is unchanged.

You can watch the build step by step in the live viewer at http://127.0.0.1:8773/#part.FCStd.
